answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 16536 Country: Pakistan Title: aoa, I have a question about paying Zakat on a plot. I own a house and pay yearly zakat on my wealth. I also purchased an additional plot worth Rs. 13 lac, with following intention: 1. I will sell it if I need money, for any important matter, in future. 2. or, I will sell it & buy a bigger plot, for my children's living, when I have enough money. Do I have to pay zakat on this plot price? Question: aoa, I have a question about paying Zakat on a plot. I own a house and pay yearly zakat on my wealth. I also purchased an additional plot worth Rs. 13 lac, with following intention: 1. I will sell it if I need money, for any important matter, in future. 2. or, I will sell it & buy a bigger plot, for my children's living, when I have enough money. Do I have to pay zakat on this plot price? Answer ID: 16536 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1885/1482/D=1430) If a plot is purchased with the intention of business, one will have to pay its zakah as per its existing value. In both the cases, there is no Zakah on the price of the plot. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
